0022600189.text: The Denver Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest) take on the Indiana Pacers (3-6, 10th in the East) in the NBA Mexico City Game, a neutral-site meeting in Mexico City where Denver is the designated road team. Denver will be without DeRozan (back spasms), Strawther (knee sprain) and Jones (hamstring), while Indiana is missing Sheppard (knee), Furphy (knee surgery), Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), McConnell (hamstring strain) and Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver swept the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 135-120 win in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
